phases.title: The Villager transformation
phases.summary: Same vault features, new clean home at vaults.sgit.ai: API + web in one repo, one image, own Lambda/CFN/Terraform, fresh history, README-test docs.

phases.title: Vault services: vaults managing vaults
phases.summary: Key management, key-value, secrets as curated 'app' endpoints that only return ciphertext; PKI-signed requests; rotation + backup as a built-in orchestration; observability; easy deploy for agents, humans and CI.

PKI-signed requests
steps.gate: signed request verified on one route

steps.title: Rotation + backup orchestration
steps.gate: weekly rotate/backup runs against a test deployment

steps.title: Observability of vault traffic
steps.gate: per-vault read/write counts visible without touching plaintext

steps.title: Deploy for agents/humans/CI

decisions.title: Python package name
decisions.recommendation: sgit_vaults (+ sgit_vaults__ui); the rename is the major bump

decisions.title: History pointer wording
decisions.recommendation: README: taken from __Send @ 5d50ae8; paths in pack 01

decisions.title: Lambda artefact
decisions.recommendation: one container image everywhere, gated on cold-start measurement

decisions.title: Existing vault data
decisions.recommendation: one-time S3 copy at cutover; old host read-only 90 days

decisions.title: Hosted auth
decisions.recommendation: remote lookup → Send Admin (transitional) for hosted; env single key for self-host; registry is phase 2

decisions.title: UI clean-up depth
decisions.recommendation: flatten the build output, no component edits; renames after cutover

decisions.title: Domains + CLI default
decisions.recommendation: vaults.sgit.ai / dev.vaults.sgit.ai; old hosts 301 for the grace period

decisions.title: Team
decisions.recommendation: restart the Villager team; this pack is its handover brief
